# Settings — Per app
{: .no_toc }

Override global settings and set app-specific preferences from the app's settings_schema.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `SET-02` |
| **Route** | `/settings/apps/:appId` · deep link `substratal://settings/apps/:appId` |
| **Where** | Personal › Settings |
| **Who can use it** | Self, active entitlement |
| **Kind** | settings |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (Phase 2) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwPreferencesPage` |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Schema form | generated rows | settings_schema properties × AppSettingsResolved.resolved | string+enum → select; string → text; string date-time → date-time picker; boolean → toggle; integer/number with min/max → stepper/number; object/array → read-only JSON preview | SchemaForm |
| Source caption | caption per row | AppSettingsResolved.sources[key] | app_override → "Changed for this app · Reset"; global → "Using your global setting"; app_default → "App default" | GtkLabel .caption .dim-label |
| Reset | link per overridden row | PATCH overrides {key:null} |  | AdwActionRow activatable |
| Push notifications for this app | toggle | resolved notifications.push; override via overrides.notifications.push | source caption as other rows; Reset clears the override | AdwSwitchRow |
| Stale overrides | banner | AppSettingsResolved.stale_overrides | "Some saved settings no longer apply" → Clear | AdwBanner |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Change row | `PATCH /users/me/apps/{appId}/settings {overrides:{key:value}} (If-Match)` | 422 → field error from details (enum_mismatch, out_of_range, undeclared_key). |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES

## For developers

Loads: `GET /applications/{appId} (settings_schema)` · `GET /users/me/apps/{appId}/settings`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
